newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber lower in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber lower in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices softened in late trading on Tuesday after deals in Medan, traders said.
Traders said European buyers bought SIR20 at 49.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan for August shipment and at 48.875 fob Palembang, sparking falls in offer prices in other cities.
Offer prices were quoted at 49.50 fob Medan and at 49.00 fob Palembang in the morning. "There has been sporadic buying in the market but overall demand remains thin," said one trader.
"Buyers are looking for August shipment onward even though many traders have yet to sell their May/June stocks," he added.
Traders said offer prices fell to 48.75 fob Surabaya from 49.25 in the morning while SIR20 was quoted at 48.50 fob Padang.
Offer prices softened to 48.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi compared with 48.75 and 49.00 respectively in the morning.
"Traders have lowered the offer prices after the deals in Medan but they are still reluctant to sell because levels are too low," said one trader.
He said trading was restricted by a holiday in Thailand and the Moslem Eid al-Adha holiday in Indonesia on Friday.
